text: Never have I ever shown up to the wrong classroom.
Never have I ever pretended to be busy to avoid a conversation.
Never have I ever ghosted someone after one date.
Never have I ever had a crush on a friend's roommate.
Never have I ever pretended to like a gift I actually hated.
Never have I ever skipped a class just because I didn't feel like getting up.
Never have I ever stalked someone's social media before meeting them in person.
Never have I ever texted an ex when I probably shouldn't have.
Never have I ever taken credit for a group project I barely helped with.
Never have I ever cried in a public place on campus.
Never have I ever pretended to be sick to get out of plans.
Never have I ever hooked up with someone I met that same night.
Never have I ever had a crush on someone in this room.
Never have I ever lied to a friend about where I really was.
Never have I ever been caught checking out someone I shouldn't have.
Never have I ever kept a secret from my closest friend for over a year.
Never have I ever had feelings for someone while I was already with someone else.
Never have I ever regretted a hookup the morning after.
Never have I ever snooped through someone's phone.
Never have I ever said 'I love you' and not meant it.
Never have I ever had a situationship I never told anyone about.
